original_record.question: Which of the following describes a characteristic of arthropods?

options.A: The organism finds it easy to grow freely
options.B: the organism has a pair of jointed appendages
options.C: the body is not divided into a number of segments seg
options.D: the body is covered by chitin

records.hold_reason: Jointed appendages and a chitin-containing exoskeleton are both arthropod features. The singular pair wording is ambiguous rather than clearly false, so B and D cannot be reliably distinguished.
